guidance: Globally unique identifier for the resource. Use a persistent, resolvable IRI when possible.

At least include agent(s) responsible for curating the metadata entry of the resource in the knowledge base. Also agents curating the data itself can be added.
Type of entity or dataset accepted as input by the computation.

Parent class of the documented class. Individuals must not use subClassOf. Particularly important for computation types: the type of assessment (see SSbD core ontology, Assessments module) must be specified.
Main controlled category or SSbD thematic area of the resource.
Human-readable title of the resource. For classes, label is preferred.
